scope: Stock PoB2 native Ward costs only; does not add infusion uptime or a whole-combat simulation
preconditions: Data/Costs.lua already defines Ward, WardPercent, WardPerMinute and their native Divisor values
CalcTools.calcLib.mod already combines resource-specific and generic cost efficiency
Installer must verify exact input hashes, back up original bytes, and restore them on uninstall
Applying API files alone does not install this calculator patch
rounding: Native upfront rounding applies to Ward only in this stock backport. Existing Mana/Life/ES/Soul/Rage calculations are preserved.
